name: diosmin
summary: Human RCT evidence supports diosmin for improving symptoms of chronic venous insufficiency and hemorrhoidal disease.
description: Diosmin has human RCT support for chronic venous insufficiency and hemorrhoids, consistent with effects on venous tone, microcirculation, and inflammatory mediators.
safetyNotes: GI upset, headache, and rash possible; generally well tolerated.
